description: Filter lists the native blocker may download between application releases, keyed by the immutable ruleset ID. Only lists named here are ever downloaded, and only when ruleset-attributions.json does not mark them reviewRequired. Each URL is the list file already recorded as the list's sourceUrl in ruleset-attributions.json. Every other list uses only the ruleset bundled with the application. A downloaded copy replaces the list's bundled network rules after validation; its bundled cosmetic, scriptlet and strictblock data stay in use.
